nodes.summary: Let $d \ge 0$ be an integer and let $f : \mathbb{R}^d \to \mathbb{R}$ be Borel measurable. Identify $\mathbb{R}^d \times \mathbb{R}$ with $\mathbb{R}^{d+1}$ by taking the last coordinate as $y$. Then the graph $\Gamma = \{(x, y) \in \mathbb{R}^d \times \mathbb{R} : y = f(x)\}$ is a Borel measurable subset of $\mathbb{R}^{d+1}$ and has Lebesgue measure $0$.
nodes.title: The graph of a measurable function is a null set

nodes.summary: Let $X$ be a second-countable topological space, $Y$ a measurable space with a measure $\mu$, $f : X \to Y$ a function and $s \subseteq X$. If every point $x \in s$ has a neighbourhood $V$ with $\mu(f(V \cap s)) = 0$, then $\mu(f(s)) = 0$.
nodes.title: Sets with locally null image have null image

nodes.summary: A nonzero multivariate polynomial over a nondiscrete locally compact second-countable Hausdorff topological field has an additive Haar-null zero set. This includes the empty variable type.
nodes.title: Nonzero polynomials over nondiscrete fields have Haar-null zero sets
